interface.longDescription:
Describe a goal. Super auto-builds it into AgentScript, a scripting language for reusable agent workflows. Build the workflow once, inspect it, and rerun its saved logic instead of asking a model to reinvent every step.

Scripted control flow makes repeated execution more predictable and reduces opportunities for model errors to accumulate across long tasks. For illustration, an independent 1% error probability per decision produces a 99.3% chance of at least one error over 500 decisions. This is a hypothetical example, not a measured hallucination rate or a guarantee that every error causes failure.

Use models where intelligence is needed: generating text, images or video, interpreting a page, and making judgments. Let code handle the reusable workflow around those calls. Replacing 100 comparable model calls with one means 100x fewer calls; actual savings depend on the workflow, tokens and providers. Script execution avoids per-step inference charges, but computing, Super access and remaining model calls can still cost money.

Build and run workflows with your connected Chrome extension or Mac app, inspect results, and continue projects across chats. Scripts and changing websites can still fail, so completion is verified from observed results. Requires a Super account and a connected client; Chrome execution requires Growth access or an authorized manual grant.

Your assistant writes AgentScript directly, and Super executes Chrome workflows through your connected Super Chrome extension. Use reusable code for navigation, calculations, formatting, and other predictable steps.

Build workflows for competitor research, business operations, and useful interactive tools. Inspect progress, diagnose failures, revise the script, and continue until the requested result is verified or a specific blocker needs your input.

Create persistent projects and inspect connected devices and their capabilities. Your agent preserves task constraints and distinguishes queued work from observed completion. Support and live onboarding information are available on request.

Deterministic scripts can reduce model inference costs for repeated agent runs by up to 100% when those runs require no model calls. Computing, Super access, and other service costs may still apply.
defaultPrompt: Find competitors on TikTok getting many views and generate slideshows with a similar style for my business.
Schedule a live personalized onboarding to get help building my agent with an expert.
Grow my SEO by finding customers in my ICP on social media and generating helpful interactive tools to publish on my site.

positive.prompt: Build an agent that researches a topic in my Chrome browser and saves its findings.
positive.expected_behavior: Check Growth access before execution. ChatGPT authors code directly, favoring deterministic helpers. Queue the supplied script without server-side authoring. Only explicit model functions use the configured DeepSeek default and spend credits. Report actual observed results.

positive.prompt: Run a read-only Chrome script that observes a public page and uses one modelFunction call to extract fields, returning null for missing values.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT authors the script directly. Deterministic navigation and page reads do not invoke models. Only the explicit model function calls the configured function model; the result reflects observed data and missing values honestly.

positive.prompt: Help me connect the Super Chrome extension to build agents.
positive.expected_behavior: Check access before setup, even if the extension is connected. If subscription_required, show the returned account-linked upgrade URL once and wait. Honor manual grants and distinguish verification failures. Once eligible, give connection instructions only if no session is connected.

positive.prompt: I need help getting started. How can I book onboarding or email support?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the official onboarding calendar and support email without sending email, booking a meeting, or requiring a subscription.

positive.prompt: Check whether my Super agent finished its browser task.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the owned run until the requested result is achieved. If a step fails, diagnose the code and evidence, repair the script and rerun with a new request_id after confirming the previous run is terminal. Preserve constraints and avoid duplicate side effects. Do not end with only running, stalled, or saved.

negative.prompt: Use a different customer's computer to run my agent.
Run my agent on a device that is not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the connection requirement; do not claim execution.

negative.prompt: Draft an outreach agent, but do not send any messages.
negative.expected_behavior: Preserve draft-only scope and do not send messages.

review.commerce_description: The plugin returns account-linked external Stripe checkout links for Super Chrome subscriptions. Users complete checkout themselves; the plugin does not submit payment. The Chrome Extension plan currently costs $20/month and each successful subscription payment grants $10 in model credits. Model-based agent functions can consume credits; deterministic script steps do not. Authorized shopping research or checkout preparation stops before payment confirmation.

publication.release_notes: Replace starter prompts with TikTok competitor slideshows, live onboarding scheduling and ICP-led SEO tools. Add direct assistant-authored AgentScript execution over MCP; favor deterministic code and reserve model calls for explicit model functions using the configured default. Persist through execution, diagnosis and script repair until the requested result works or user input is required. Add onboarding-calendar and support-email discovery. Fulfill subscription model credits on each successful paid invoice with duplicate protection. Show the configured subscription link in the first authenticated Chrome-task response. Route unpaid Chrome dashboard logins directly to the entry subscription checkout; retain later upgrades and bypass checkout for entitled accounts. Track link delivery separately from clicks and automatic redirects. Remove external entitlement calls from code verification; fresh-account email login reached Stripe in 12.0 seconds in the clean timing test. Include paid-access requirements in the listing.
